name: CueFrame API
description:
CueFrame public REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer cf_live_*` / `cf_test_*` keys, or use x402 EIP-3009 payments on priced endpoints. Every endpoint is org-scoped; cross-org access returns 404 (not 403) to avoid leaking resource existence.

See: https://docs.cueframe.ai
